test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 'P&Q' indicates that 'P is the son of Q', and 'P$Q' indicates that 'P is the sister of Q', then which of the following expressions would indicate that 'Y is the mother of Z'?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599c31a3b6c5ca06ce1787b908a152975e0540fada6e60ee63a4282f38f5a661.png] 

If 'P&Q' indicates that 'P is the son of Q', and 'P$Q' indicates that 'P is the sister of Q'.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 &
 $
 
 

 **Meaning**
 Son
 Sister
 
 

 

1) Z$Y&X → Z is sister of Y, Y is son of X

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28eae5c80c0fbda829c31b40f3d5123b478319125c1e5287a626ca4ffca2943e.png] 

Y is brother of Z.

2) X&Y$Z → X is son of Y, Y is sister of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d45e1c98b766429a1fae934c24ea2c746ee07def01515e3d68f9afa2c50fef8.png] 

Y is sister of Z.

3) X$Y&Z → X is sister of Y, Y is son of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6075161da9dc3292e460b175609b7dba285880a7af30c98afed4eb1ecd2b95a7.png] 

Y is son of Z.

4) Z&Y$X → **Z is son of Y, Y is sister of X.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce9b371bbcc7d045c8d73eee8fa2a08661558f85d48975d74b30a621075a4c04.png] 

**Y is mother of Z.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Z&Y$X".**
